# A03 Labs

> A03 Labs is a software studio that designs, builds, and ships web and mobile
> products for startups and growing teams. We treat architecture as seriously
> as code — discovery, design, and a real plan before a single sprint starts.

## What we do

- **Web & Product Development** — Full-stack web and mobile applications built
  for speed, scale, and maintainability.
- **Product Design** — User-centered UI/UX design that turns complex problems
  into simple, usable products.
- **Cloud & DevOps** — Infrastructure, CI/CD, and cloud architecture so teams
  ship with confidence.
- **Technical Consulting** — Hands-on advisory for teams navigating
  architecture decisions and technical debt.

## How we work

Our process runs in a fixed sequence, not ad-hoc sprints:

1. **Discovery** — Understand the business, the users, and the real problem,
   not just the feature list.
2. **Design & Architecture** — Define user flows, data models, and API
   contracts upfront.
3. **Build** — Focused development cycles with regular demos and working
   software early.
4. **Launch** — Full deployment, monitoring setup, and knowledge transfer.
5. **Support** — Ongoing iteration and a long-term engineering partnership.

Clients get direct access to the engineers building their product (not an
account manager relaying to outsourced contractors), and a working demo every
cycle instead of a status update once a sprint.

## Selected work

- **Dr Ibiso Hart** (https://www.dribisohart.com/) — Personal brand site for a
  certified lifestyle coach, built to convert visitors into discovery-session
  bookings.
- **Lifematics Lifestyle** (https://lifematicswithdribisohart.com/) — Coaching
  platform bringing together courses, workshops, and content under one brand.
